exposure: receptor activator of nuclear factor kB (RANK)
outcome: spontaneous preterm birth (sPTB) before 34 gestational weeks
cohort: The study included 46 women with spontaneous preterm birth before 34 gestational weeks and 46 women with normal pregnancies and term deliveries from a low-risk population.
finding: A combination of inflammation-associated plasma proteins from the second trimester (IL-10, IL-6, RANK) showed good predictive ability for spontaneous preterm birth before 34 gestational weeks, while first-trimester prediction (HGF) was less effective.
gest_age: The study focused on sPTB before 34 gestational weeks, with plasma samples collected at gestational week 11 (range 7-16) and gestational week 25 (range 23-30).
